title: The Stigmata
text: At a shrine, a Scion's hands begin to bleed, slowly and then steadily, from wounds in the palms that were not there a moment ago. It does not hurt. The monks fall to their knees, weeping and praying, staring.

options.label: Accept it as a sign, and bleed as the Six will it.

outcomes.text: In the monks' eyes they are holy now. Their hands do not stop bleeding for days.

options.label: Bind the hands and go, before the monks make a saint of them.

outcomes.text: The bleeding stops at the town's edge. The monks bless every one of you as you go, and the blessing turns spells aside.

options.label: The shrewdest makes the most of it; miracles are good for business.

outcomes.text: Donations pour in. The monks will never know what the Six thought of it.

options.label: The Ravager tastes the blood to know if it is truly holy.

outcomes.text: The monks scream. The Ravager does not care; the blood is holy, and it burns going down like a war-cry.
